t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree
And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree

ayahs.arabic: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahrin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months

ayahs.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter
Peace it is until the emergence of dawn
